transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. I'm here because... well, ever since these foreclosure notices started coming in the mail, I just feel like I’m coming apart at the seams. 

It's getting really bad. I've been sitting in my truck crying before I even go into work, and I jump every single time my phone rings. It's messing up my job, too. I'm a mechanic, and lately I'm just... I'm snapping at the apprentices and making these stupid mistakes in the repair bay that I never, ever would’ve made before. I just can't seem to keep it together right now.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I really have. I just... I don't have it in me anymore. 

Like I mentioned with work, because of those mistakes, they actually took me out of the high-risk repair bay. But it's outside of work, too. I've just stopped showing up for things I used to do all the time. I used to volunteer at my church, go to fitness classes, and I was pretty active with these truck-club outings. I always used to keep up with all of that, but lately... I just don't go. I don't even want to.
Have you had any thoughts of killing yourself or that you would be better off dead?

No, I haven't. I mean, things are really hard right now, and I feel overwhelmed, but I've never thought about hurting myself or anything like that. I just want to figure out how to get through this mess.
Have you been feeling persistently nervous or worried because of the foreclosure situation?

No, I wouldn't really say I feel nervous... or worried, exactly. I mean, I know I said I jump when the phone rings, but it's not like I'm sitting around constantly worrying about things all day. It's more just... I just feel completely overwhelmed by the whole thing, like I just can't handle it. But no, not really nervous.

It's been... about four months now. Yeah, right around four months. It basically started right when those foreclosure notices started coming in the mail, and I've just been feeling like this ever since.
During these four months, how often have you felt sad, depressed, or down?

I'm not really sure how to answer that... I mean, I wouldn't say I feel sad or depressed, exactly. It's more just... heavy, you know? Like I'm just dragging myself through the days. But I wouldn't call it sadness. Just completely overwhelmed.
Do you feel down or depressed for most of the day, nearly every day?

No, not really. I mean, I don't think so. Like I said, it's not really a depressed feeling. I don't wake up feeling sad or anything. I just feel... bogged down by it all, I guess. But no, I wouldn't say I feel down most of the day.
When you are not thinking about the foreclosure, do you still find that you cannot enjoy things you normally would?

No, I wouldn't say that. If I can actually get my mind off the house... like if I'm at the shop working on a rig, or just hanging out and not thinking about the mail, I can still enjoy myself. I still like doing my normal stuff. It's just that the foreclosure is usually always right there in the back of my head. But if I'm actually distracted from it, yeah, I can still have a good time.
Since the foreclosure problems began, have you done anything that seriously broke rules or harmed other people, such as fighting, threatening someone, or damaging property?

No, definitely not. I mean... I'm stressed out, sure, but no, I haven't done anything like that. I'm not getting into fights or breaking things or... whatever else. I just go to the shop, do my job, and try to figure out this mess with the house. I haven't threatened anyone or caused any trouble.
